verb.load: Q holds this member's rows for the KV traversal; each K half uses one page per member. Both members contribute to pair-wide readiness.
Each V half uses two page transfers per member; done covers both and contributes to pair-wide readiness independently of K.

verb.qk: Issue one QK channel half; d=0 initializes S and d=1 completes it. Done returns K; last QK returns Q. Ordered pair products read earlier P before later QK overwrites its aliased slot.
verb.pv: Issue one PV output half; i=0 initializes Y and later blocks use corrected Y. Done returns V; d=1 publishes Y and returns P, covering both CTAs.

verb.capture: Capture scores and return their slot; use the load-reduced maximum for the fully visible prefix, and recompute after masking the causal/tail suffix.
verb.publish: Build immutable RequestMap once per CTA and release all roles after CTA-wide visibility; Stats carries old maximum and base; P applies online with per-tile state reset; FinalSum publishes ell(N-1) after all blocks.

verb.capture: Acknowledge first-block Stats without reading its payload; capture later Stats and final ell into registers before returning their slots.
verb.rescale: Evaluate alpha from Stats and correct both Y halves after previous PV; a warp vote skips rewriting when no row has alpha<1, retaining the ownership handshake.
verb.stage: Normalize and narrow one Y half into OutputStage; completion covers the correction group.
verb.store: Coalesced valid-row stores undo head packing; completion ends OutputStage reads and includes the group barrier before reuse.
verb.release: All Y reads are complete; the next tile may initialize Y while the final staged half is being stored.

verb.load:
KVStage is a token, with K at p=max(0,2*i-1) and V at p=min(2*i+2,2*N-1), each with halves d=0,1.
Issue K0,K1,V0,K2,V1,...,Klast,Vpenultimate,Vlast; N=1 uses K0,V0. Separate payload arrays share one four-token acquire/release stream.
Q contains this member's rows; K uses one page per member/half and V uses two. Both members contribute to pair-wide readiness.

verb.contract:
K tokens perform QK, initializing S at d=0 and completing at d=1; V tokens perform PV, initializing Y at i=0 and using corrected Y thereafter.
Completion covers both CTAs and returns the operand token. Ordered products read earlier P before a later QK overwrites its aliased slot.

verb.load: Issue cp.async copies; PartialLSE includes -inf padding. The first three partial prefetches may read unspecified empty-split payloads; later copies skip splits beyond each thread-owned row group's last nonempty split.

publish.meaning: Wait for LSE copies and rendezvous the CTA; compute combine weights and per-row LastValidSplit, overwrite LSEWeight, then rendezvous before consuming the transposed weights.

accumulate.meaning: Wait for the current partial stage; initialize Facc before s=0 and apply combine. Each warp owns one row; skip nonpositive weights and iterations beyond its last valid split. Reads are thread-private, so no per-stage CTA barrier is needed.

store.meaning: Narrow Facc to BF16 and coalescently store its valid output slice.
